title: Understanding Visualizations
text: Consider what types of plots are typically used to visualize a single numerical variable like price.

title: Types of Plots
text: Think about common plots such as histograms, line plots, and scatter plots. Which ones are suitable for showing the distribution or trend of a single variable?

title: Line Plot Suitability
text: Is a line plot suitable for visualizing the price of drinks?

title: Line Plot Characteristics
text: Line plots are typically used to show trends over time. Does the price data have a time component?

title: Histogram Suitability
text: Would a histogram be a suitable visualization for the price data?

title: Histogram Characteristics
text: Histograms are used to show the distribution of a single numerical variable. Does this apply to the price data?
